gaps: Confirm the specific training details for each lot to ensure alignment with the RFP requirements.
Verify the compliance of regional support centers with all specified criteria, including duration, client references, and staff qualifications.
Ensure that all required expert roles are covered by individuals with the necessary experience and qualifications.
Obtain and include the reference from the group leader as required by the RFP.

paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the requirement for contractors to provide training for their respective lots as specified in the RFP (PM-04). The proposer confirms that training for the Owner's operators and maintainers will be provided for the equipment and systems included in the respective lots. This training will cover operation, maintenance, and other relevant aspects as detailed in the responses from the respective contractors.

Regarding the requirement for a regional support center with specific capabilities, the proposer notes that several contractors partially comply with this requirement. While support will be provided through regional service centers with English-speaking staff, further confirmation is needed to ensure compliance with all specified criteria, including the duration of operation, client references, and staff qualifications.

The proposer has identified the availability of experts with at least three years of experience in the specified roles, as required by the RFP. While some contractors fully comply by naming all required experts, others partially comply by providing experts for specific roles relevant to their scope of work. The proposer will ensure that all required roles are covered by qualified individuals.

The proposer confirms that the composition of the bidding group will remain unchanged between submission and award, as required by the RFP. Additionally, the group leader will provide the necessary references to support the proposal.
